summary: GORGEOUS FOUR BEDROOM DETACHED PROPERTY WITH SEA VIEWS My Property Box is delighted to bring to the market this four bedroom DETACHED house located on the Marine Point development in Hartlepool. Come and have a look at a detached spacious property with spectacular sea views, convenient for Hartlepool and the larger areas of Teesside via the A19 commuting from your Sea front home will be no problem. Briefly comprising hallway, lounge, dining room (second reception room), large Kitchen family room with patio doors and spectacular sea views to the rear, utility and WC to the ground floor. Spacious Master bedroom with en-suite shower room and french doors leading to a balcony where you can enjoy those stunning sea views, three further bedrooms and the family bathroom, on the first floor.
